typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		LoadDate as timestamp,
		Total_compensations as integer,
		Metric_status as string,
		As_Of_date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Total_Compensation as integer,
		Metric_status as string,
		As_Of_date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		Total_Compensation = Total_compensations,
		Metric_status,
		As_Of_date),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
